name: 3DO Interactive Multiplayer
_notes: A/B/C run left to right like the Genesis, so they use the genesis convention (west/south/east). [VERIFY] against Opera libretro defaults. P (Play/Pause) acts as Start and X (Stop) as Select. 3DO menus commonly confirm on A; cancel=C is a judgment call. The flightstick and mouse are not modelled.
